notes.title: Update notes 7th of March 2023, v 0.9.24
notes.content: Small update to Upgrade selection in the "random" mode selection screen, you can now directly press A to select the upgrade as your choice and no longer need to go to the select button.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.9.23
notes.content:
Biggest change this update is that controller support is now live, at least from my personal testing it works from start to finish.
I have also made some minor balance changes but waiting for more data to be able to do better and more focused changes.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update notes for 19th January 2023
notes.content:
I have made it possible to use gamepad in starting selection and during gameplay so even if you have a gamepad you can now use the mouse to at least select upgrades since before you could do nothing when a gamepad was connected.
I will keep working on gamepad support!

notes.title: Update 1 December 2022
notes.content:
The new big thing is the endless mode, you can now play for as long as you like. 
See below for rest of the changes.

[list]
[*] Added an endless mode for infinite play
[*] BUGFIX: Retry should reuse the selected base mod (add it again)
[*] BALANCE: Less enemies per wave
[*] BALANCE: Update of enemy hp scaling
[*] BALANCE: Less projectiles and speed for end enemies
[/list]

Trying to keep updates short and to the point for the time being.
